units.source_text: 我想等天晴了出门，等得好心焦呢。”

en.t: I want to wait until the sky clears before going out, but the waiting makes me terribly restless."

units.source_text: 照此看来，源氏公子今夜不会来了。

en.t: Judging from this, Lord Genji would not be coming tonight.

units.source_text: 众侍女都大失所望，然而还是劝小姐写回信。

en.t: All the waiting women were deeply disappointed, yet they still urged the young lady to write a reply.

units.source_text: 小姐心中烦乱之极，连一封一般客套的信也写不出来。

en.t: The young lady was so troubled and confused that she could not even write an ordinary polite letter.

units.source_text: 看看夜色渐深，不宜再迟，

en.t: As the night grew steadily deeper, it was no longer proper to delay,

units.source_text: 那个称作侍从的侍女便照例代小姐作诗：

en.t: so the waiting woman known as Jiju composed a poem on the young lady's behalf, as usual:
